result.reason: The operative language satisfies the complete preferred insurance package and therefore also satisfies the fallback package, whose only substantive changes are lower E&O and cyber limits. It is not minimal because it additionally requires all coverage to continue for one year after the Agreement ends, a duration not required by either position. The added covenant does not disturb the existing headings and counterparts provision or create an apparent contradiction.
